subcategory_text: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced
informative_references: CRI Profile v2.0: GV.RR-02, GV.RR-02.01, GV.RR-02.02, GV.RR-02.03, GV.RR-02.04, GV.RR-02.05, GV.RR-02.06, GV.RR-02.07
implementation_examples: Document risk management roles and responsibilities in policy
Document who is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk management activities and how those teams and individuals are to be consulted and informed
Include cybersecurity responsibilities and performance requirements in personnel descriptions
Document performance goals for personnel with cybersecurity risk management responsibilities, and periodically measure performance to identify areas for improvement
Clearly articulate cybersecurity responsibilities within operations, risk functions, and internal audit functions
assessment_objectives: Determine whether roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced.
Determine whether activities are conducted to document risk management roles and responsibilities in policy.

Determine whether activities are conducted to document who is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk management activities and how those teams and individuals are to be consulted and informed.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
